text: Kepler | Full Stack Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K-$260K + equity We're building the trust layer for AI in high-stakes industries. LLMs hallucinate, so they can't be the thing producing your numbers. In Kepler, the LLM orchestrates (decides what data to gather, what to compute, how to structure the output), but the model never touches the data itself.
